metadata.title: Thai Buddhist Calendar Dates 1970-2100
metadata.calendar: Thai lunisolar calendar via pythaidate CsDate
notes: Dates are generated by rule calculation, not by annual government announcement import.
Substitute public holidays are not included.
Sao Ha is exported as candidate dates matched by rule; temple-specific confirmation is not included.
Asalha Bucha is used internally as the base date for Khao Phansa but is not exported as a separate requested event.
